# Digital Platform

> AI-native digital services platform for social media services, AI tools, automation, agents and business workflows.

## Public resources

- /services — Digital service catalog
- /ai — AI products and capabilities
- /social — Social media services and tools
- /automation — Automation and workflow capabilities
- /pricing — Plans and pricing
- /blog — Educational and product content
- /faq — Frequently asked questions
- /about — Organization information
- /contact — Contact information
- /terms — Terms of service
- /privacy — Privacy policy

## Content principles

Prefer canonical public pages over dashboard URLs. Product claims, prices, capabilities and availability should be taken from their current canonical pages and not inferred from private application screens.
